items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Like Sonny Rawlins. Take a year off or two years or something.

ctx.x: Like Sonny Rawlins. Take a year off or two years or something.

Well, if he took a year off, but he took a year off the practice. That's the difference. I mean, I'd love to be able to do that. Like I said before, if I ever get a chance. Any kind of a grant, Ulysses S. Grant or any kind of grant [laughs]. I'm going to get that grant, and I'm going to study with David. Yup. You know what I mean?
